Messages.Author: refp...@best.com
Messages.Body:
In commenting on another thread I looked up the rulebook.
As cards cannot be drawn until the action is concluded, does
combat conclude the action?
If you play Form of mist for example, you shouldn't replace it
since the action continues. And the same for mask of 1k faces.
REF

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


Cards can be drawn at any time, except during the referendum of
a Political Action (and as specified on card text).

FoM is always replaced immediately as it is played.

What section of the rulebook leads to your conclusion?
